course_name: 科技發展與法律策略：案例研析
outline: In responding to the technological advancement, the landscape of irreplaceable legal knowledge and skill sets are undergoing a transformation period.  By case discussions and active engagement with the guest lecturers from the industry, the tutor will equip students with a systematic knowledge of the current interplay of (IP)law and technology,  and prepare them for the legal changes in the future.
schedule: The schedule of this course will be released to students at the first class and possible amendments might be made to accommodate students' backgrounds.
assessment: Course participation : 30%, course assignments: 30%, final report :40.
